newsitem.title: USA: Transcend Therapeutics refiles for IPO with Everen.
newsitem.headline: Transcend Therapeutics refiles for IPO with Everen.

text.p: Transcend Therapeutics will try a third time at going public, this time with EVEREN Securities, according to documents filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

The pharmaceutical company makes products to treat diseases caused by oxidative stress and resulting tissue damage. The new filing says Transcend offer more shares but cut the price, selling 2.455 million shares at $10 to $12, bringing the value of IPO to about $27 million.

Cambridge, Massachusetts-based Transcend filed for a $26 million IPO last August with Vector Securities, which was subsequently pulled. In March, it refiled to raise the same amount but said Boehringer Ingelheim International GmbH would buy $5 million of the IPO shares as part of a licensing pact. That IPO, of 2 million shares to price at $12 to $14 each, was also postponed. Boehringer is the company's partner in a procysteine development program.
All the shares will be sold by Transcend. The proposed trading symbol on the Nasdaq is "TNSD".
Boehringer is still interested in buying $5 million of the shares, according to the new filing.
